comment: The phase CV branch is guarded by getInput(CLK_PHASE_INPUTS + 0).isConnected() inside the loop over all four clocks, so clock 1's phase jack decides whether every clock reads its jack or its knob; with clock 1 patched and clock 3 not, clock 3 reads 0V from an empty jack instead of its knob. MIN_GATE_LEN and MAX_GATE_LEN are 10 and 90, contradicting the manual's 5% to 95% for the CV inputs. MAX_PHASE_SHIFT is 0.25, contradicting the manual's half a cycle. MAX_SWING_AMOUNT is 9.999 and the swing jack maps 0 to 10V onto 0 to 9.999 per cent, contradicting the manual's -5% to 5%. The BPM CV has no bounds check while every other CV input here does. Swing is applied as (1 - 2 * random) * amount * 0.01, recomputed after each gate.
